title: Paper Towels 6-roll

drivers.name: Promotion: 20% off
drivers.evidence: Past 20% off promotions: x1.95, x1.25; 15% off: x2.58, x1.72; 30% off: x2.18; noise-adjusted estimate x2.09; but only 16 occurrences, so shrink toward 1.0. This is a 20% off, not 30%, so lower than 30% off lift.

adjustment.analysis: The 20% off promotion is similar in magnitude to past 20% discounts (x1.95, x1.25), but the classical uplift model’s x2.09 is based on only 16 past occurrences and may overstate the effect. The 30% off promotion (x2.18) was stronger, but this is a 20% discount. The 15% off promotions averaged x2.15. A 20% discount should lift demand, but not as much as a 30% off. The past 20% off week after promotion saw x0.82, but no such effect is expected here as this is not a follow-up week. The baseline already reflects a seasonal trend (14.3% rise in 13 weeks). The noise-adjusted estimate for 20% off is x2.09, but evidence is thin. Shrink toward 1.0. No other drivers.
